summary.headline: Codex Vaticanus 1453
summary.text: Catalogue of Vatican Codex 1452 material cross-referenced with Florentine Codex 12: Roman and Arab months, solar daily degrees, Hermes, Galen, Theophilus, Petosiris, Syrus, Julianus, and earthquake theory attributed to Lydus. Begins the description of Codex Vaticanus 1453, a tenth-century parchment manuscript containing a paraphrase of Ptolemy’s Tetrabiblos attributed to Proclus and a chapter on the seven planets.
